import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.math.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, t, counter, source_cap[][] = new int[10][10], sink_cap[][] = new int[10][10], source_num[][] = new int[10][10], sink_num[][] = new int[10][10], plant[][][] = new int[10][10][61], flo[][] = new int[200][200];
    static int dr[] = { 0, 0, -1, 1 }, dc[] = { -1, 1, 0, 0 };
    static boolean is_valid(int r, int c) {
        if (r < 0 || r >= n || c < 0 || c >= n)
            return false;
        return true;
    }

    static int get_path() {
        int parent[] = new int[counter + 1];
        Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
        parent[0] = 0;
        Stack<Integer> dfs = new Stack<>();
        dfs.push(0);
        while (!dfs.isEmpty()) {
            int top = dfs.peek();
            dfs.pop();
            if (top == counter)
                break;
            for (int i = 0; i <= counter; i++) {
                if (flo[top][i] > 0 && parent[i] == -1) {
                    parent[i] = top;
                    dfs.push(i);
                }
            }
        }
        if (parent[counter] == -1)
            return 0;
        int ans = 10000, pos = counter;
        while (pos != 0) {
            ans = Math.min(ans, flo[parent[pos]][pos]);
            pos = parent[pos];
        }
        pos = counter;
        while (pos != 0) {
            flo[parent[pos]][pos] -= ans;
            flo[pos][parent[pos]] += ans;
            pos = parent[pos];
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        char inp[][] = new char[n][n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            inp[i] = st.nextToken().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (inp[i][j] == 'Y' || inp[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    plant[i][j][0] = inp[i][j] - 'X';
                    source_cap[i][j] = 0;
                } else {
                    plant[i][j][0] = 0;
                    source_cap[i][j] = inp[i][j] - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            inp[i] = st.nextToken().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (inp[i][j] == 'Y' || inp[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    plant[i][j][0] = inp[i][j] - 'X';
                    sink_cap[i][j] = 0;
                } else {
                    plant[i][j][0] = 0;
                    sink_cap[i][j] = inp[i][j] - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        for (int curr_time = 1; curr_time <= t; curr_time++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    plant[i][j][curr_time] = plant[i][j][curr_time - 1];
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if (plant[i][j][curr_time - 1] == 2) {
                        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                            if (is_valid(i + dr[k], j + dc[k])) {
                                if (plant[i + dr[k]][j + dc[k]][curr_time - 1] == 0)
                                    plant[i + dr[k]][j + dc[k]][curr_time] = 2;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        counter = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (source_cap[i][j] != 0) {
                    source_num[i][j] = counter;
                    counter++;
                } else
                    source_num[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (sink_cap[i][j] != 0) {
                    sink_num[i][j] = counter;
                    counter++;
                } else
                    sink_num[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        Queue<Pair<Integer, Pair<Integer, Integer>>> bfs = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (source_cap[i][j] == 0)
                    continue;
                bfs.add(new Pair<>(0, new Pair<>(i, j)));
                int source = source_num[i][j];
                boolean[][] vis = new boolean[n][n];
                vis[i][j] = true;
                while (!bfs.isEmpty()) {
                    Pair<Integer, Pair<Integer, Integer>> top = bfs.peek();
                    bfs.remove();
                    int curr_time = top.getKey(), r = top.getValue().getKey(), c = top.getValue().getValue();
                    if (sink_cap[r][c] != 0)
                        flo[source][sink_num[r][c]] = 10000;
                    if (curr_time == t)

                    for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                        if (is_valid(r + dr[k], c + dc[k]) && plant[r + dr[k]][c + dc[k]][curr_time] == 0 && !vis[r + dr[k]][c + dc[k]]) {
                            bfs.add(new Pair<>(curr_time + 1, new Pair<>(r + dr[k], c + dc[k])));
                            vis[r + dr[k]][c + dc[k]] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (source_cap[i][j] != 0)
                    flo[0][source_num[i][j]] = source_cap[i][j];
                if (sink_cap[i][j] != 0)
                    flo[sink_num[i][j]][counter] = sink_cap[i][j];
            }
        }
        int temp, ans = 0;
        while (true) {
            temp = get_path();
            if (temp == 0)
                break;
            ans += temp;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static class Pair<K, V> {
        private K key;
        private V value;

        public Pair(K key, V value) {
            this.key = key;
            this.value = value;
        }

        public K getKey() {
            return key;
        }

        public V getValue() {
            return value;
        }
    }
}
